name: com.netease.yunxin.kit.qchatkit.ui.channel.add.QChatChannelAddRoleActivity
description: The NetEase Yunxin QChat UI SDK opens this screen from a channel's permission settings. It lists server roles that can be added to the channel; selecting a role attaches it and opens its channel permission controls.
disableEffect: Users cannot add server roles to a QChat channel through the built-in permission flow.
